posts.text:
Don’t love the vague note about “digital trade alignment” in the US statement on whatever agreement is coming.

Canada is already limited in how it can regulate US tech companies due to CUSMA/USMCA. The last thing we need is for our ability to rein in those bad actors to be constrained even further.
posts.summary: Opposes digital trade constraints that would limit Canada's tech regulation
